name: PGlite Durable Intelligence Layer
description: Set up PGlite as the sole durable truth store for the Codex, dharma ledger, packet provenance, and vector embeddings. Configure pgvector HNSW indexing, pg_textsearch BM25, and live query reactivity.
purpose: Establish PGlite as the canonical evidence authority — everything durable lives here. Nothing in Valkey or DuckDB is authoritative without a corresponding PGlite record.
acceptanceCriteria: PGlite stores all diagnostic packets as JSONB with full schema validation
pgvector HNSW indexes serve symptom-signature similarity search
pg_textsearch BM25 indexes serve full-text codex queries
Live queries drive reactive cockpit UI updates
Every dharma point, packet confirmation, and status transition is an ACID transaction
Evidence ring materialized as a view over the PGlite transaction log
